fact: WHO's SCORE assessment of Cameroon (data from 2013-2018, updated 15 March 2021) records as 'Not there' a standardized system of electronic capture of patient-level health data, interoperable with the aggregate routine HIS, both in primary care health facilities and in hospitals, and 'No data' for a national unique patient identifier system.
title: SCORE for Health Data Technical Package: Assessment Summary for Cameroon
